In the published article, we mistakenly used part of the alpha velocity data from encounter 5 to encounter 8 (E5–E8), thus Figures 9 and 10 therein need to be corrected accordingly. In this erratum, we provide corrected versions of Figures 9 and 10. We note that the negative ΔVαp/VA population reduces in the current ﬁgures, but the major distributions in the two ﬁgures do not change signiﬁcantly, therefore the discussions and implications in the published article are not affected.
